content: Human-labeling session — def-engineer-repair-under-fire:hard seed 1. Objective: Your base — damaged refinery (40% HP), hold-fire defenders + engineer + pbox, safe construction yard — spawns in either the NORTH or SOUTH latitude by seed. A grenadier-led attrition wave hits from the matching latitude, with reinforcements arriving mid-engagement. Toggle REPAIR on the damaged refinery and commit the defenders via attack_unit. Win: refinery and construction yard standing, refinery healed back to at least 80% HP, at least five attackers killed, within about 30 turns. Loss: refinery falls, construction yard falls, or refinery is still under 80% HP when the clock expires.
